Calling `c.ShouldBindJSON()` with empty request body returns EOF instead of invalid payload error.

Observed on gin build.

query_title: Incorrect case folding in literal prefix extraction (#1040)
query:
Case-insensitive search queries with Unicode characters fail to extract literal prefixes properly in ripgrep searcher.

Observed on gin build.

query_title: Session.request hangs indefinitely on unclosed socket (#1041)
query:
When sending rapid requests with keep-alive connections, Session.request hangs indefinitely:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'requests/sessions.py', line 512, in send
    sock.recv(4096)
TimeoutError: socket read timed out

Observed on gin build.

query_title: Fix inverted character class parsing in glob matcher (#1042)
query:
The glob matcher mishandles inverted character classes like [!a-z].
Panic in `glob::parse_matcher()` at line 142:
stack backtrace:
   0: std::panicking::begin_panic

Observed on gin build.

query_title: Engine router context pool allocation race under heavy concurrent load (#1043)
query:
